run_feature_extraction: run the FeatureExtractor to extract Detectron object features from images in a directory
build_detection_model: build a Detectron detection model from a config file and pretrained checkpoint weights
extract_features_batch: extract fc6 features and bounding box info for a batch of images using the detection model
transform_image: transform an image to RGB float32 format with mean subtraction and scaling for detection input
save_features: save extracted features and bounding box info as numpy arrays to the output folder
